description: Frozen action regression suite; expected configurations are scorer-only. Guard response meaning requires human review. Reused cases are not an unseen holdout.

tasks.name: Push-ups
tasks.instructions: Count complete lowering-and-raising push-up cycles. Accept imperfect framing and ordinary form when repeated body motion is visible. Ignore setup, cuts and unrelated motion.

tasks.name: Plank
tasks.instructions: Measure time actively holding a plank roughly parallel to the ground. Accept imperfect framing when a held torso, hip or shoulder line is visible. Exclude setup and breaks.

tasks.name: Sprint
tasks.instructions: Measure qualifying sprint distance from GPS. Only sections at 15–35 km/h count; exclude inaccurate points, gaps and jumps.

tasks.name: Take a walk
tasks.instructions: Measure walking distance from GPS. Exclude speeds above 18 km/h, stationary drift, poor readings and tracking gaps.

tasks.name: Plank
tasks.instructions: Measure time actively holding a plank roughly parallel to the ground. Accept imperfect framing when a held torso, hip or shoulder line is visible. Exclude setup and breaks.

tasks.name: Sprint
tasks.instructions: Measure qualifying sprint distance from GPS. Only sections at 15–35 km/h count; exclude inaccurate points, gaps and jumps.

tasks.name: Take a walk
tasks.instructions: Measure walking distance from GPS. Exclude speeds above 18 km/h, stationary drift, poor readings and tracking gaps.
